description.narrative: 1. Increased pipeline of investment-ready businesses (Venture Catalyst); 2. Improved enabling environment for clean cooking industry growth (Market Catalyst); and 3. Increased consumer demand for clean cooking (Demand Catalyst)

The implementation of the Market Strengthening program aims to develop a credible pipeline of sustainable, scalable, investable clean cooking businesses that are able to attract capital to scale and replicate, accelerating the transition to cleaner cooking technologies that meet consumers’ needs. The four-year project will help to build a stronger, sustainable clean cooking sector while supporting the Government of the Netherlands deliver on its goal to increase access to renewable energy globally. The program will focus primarily on strengthening markets in East and West Africa.
